# Jashandeep Singh — Video Editor Portfolio

> High-retention commercial video editor & ACES colorist portfolio built with Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Storage). Engineered for rapid visual storytelling in DaVinci Resolve Studio across commercial launch films, YouTube long-form documentaries, and viral short-form campaigns worldwide.

## Core Pages
- [Home & Portfolio Showcase](https://www.jashandeepsingh.work/): Full portfolio featuring the hero showreel, interactive category filterable project grid, studio services tabs, 7+ year post-production track record, director testimonials, and project inquiry form.
- [Selected Work](https://www.jashandeepsingh.work/#work): Curated commercial, YouTube, documentary, and short-form video edits with duration, aspect format, client attribution, and interactive video playback modal.
- [Services & Capabilities](https://www.jashandeepsingh.work/#services): Post-production capabilities covering short-form retention editing, YouTube storytelling & essays, ACES cinematic color grading in DaVinci Resolve Studio, and multi-layer sound design.
- [Experience & Pipeline](https://www.jashandeepsingh.work/#experience): Chronological career timeline and 4-stage post-production workflow from ingest and assembly to ACES color finish and final delivery.
- [Client Validation](https://www.jashandeepsingh.work/#testimonials): Verified reviews from film directors, brand founders, and digital creators.
- [Start a Project](https://www.jashandeepsingh.work/#contact): Direct production brief intake form and scheduling links for commercial retainers and single-cut campaigns.

## Creator & Editing Expertise
- **Role:** Video Editor & ACES Colorist (Remote Worldwide — Commercial, YouTube, Short-Form)
- **Primary Tools:** DaVinci Resolve Studio (ACEScg node pipeline), Fusion VFX, After Effects, Adobe Premiere Pro, Fairlight Audio Mastering (-14 LUFS)
- **Track Record:** 120M+ organic views driven across YouTube, Instagram Reels, TikTok, LinkedIn, and commercial brand campaigns

## Platform Architecture
- **Frontend:** Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Backend & CMS:** Supabase Postgres with Row Level Security (RLS), Supabase Auth, and Supabase Storage (`portfolio-media`)
- **Machine-Readable Endpoints:** [XML Sitemap](https://www.jashandeepsingh.work/sitemap.xml) | [Robots Policy](https://www.jashandeepsingh.work/robots.txt)
